$comment: GFC Xtreme Fitness — the single source of truth for brand. Nothing user-visible is branded anywhere else: scripts/build-tokens.mjs reads this file and writes the CSS tokens, the PWA manifest and the native theme colours. Change a value here, run `npm run brand`, rebuild.

color.$comment: Sampled from the supplied logo (brand/assets/gfc-logo.png). Orange is the dominant saturated pixel at hue 16.4 deg, sat 0.84 — 409 px of exactly #FC6228 before any neighbouring shade. Contrast figures are measured, not estimated; see scripts/check-contrast.mjs.

accentPress.from: accent darkened for the pressed/active state

onAccent.from: measured: black scores 6.92 on the accent, white only 3.04

ink.from: logo field — also openGym's existing default background

surface.from: gym photo cool shadow (hue 185 deg) — depth without flat grey

line.from: logo rope graphic — hairlines and separators

assets.$logoNote: Black keyed to transparent so the mark sits on any dark surface. Replace with an SVG when the original vector turns up — the slot and the sizes stay the same.

imagery.$note: Darkened to 62% at build time so white and orange UI stays legible; the CSS lays a gradient scrim over it as well. Swap in your own gym photography here — same filenames, no code change.

logoPlacement.$comment: Where the mark appears. 'corner' is the request: upper-left of the app chrome, above the content, never scrolling away.
